scope.nonApplicableRemainder: All other strict accepted COL26.8 species assigned to Protists and Chromists remain outside this Cercozoa sidecar.
scope.boundary: This sidecar covers only strict accepted COL26.8 species descending from exact Cercozoa root 35. ITIS TSN 969919 is the exact accepted Cercozoa division, but its 2026-08-26 hierarchy has no accepted species descendants; broader ITIS lineages such as Fungi are intentionally excluded.

rootBoundaryAudit.decision: Use only the exact ITIS Cercozoa division TSN 969919. Do not substitute the older ITIS Fungi/Myxomycota hierarchy, which would create false cross-root coverage and duplicate unrelated taxa.

normalization: Remove the exact trailing COL authorship field from COL scientificName when that suffix is present; no authorship parser is used.
Normalize Unicode to NFC, replace underscores with spaces, collapse Unicode whitespace and trim.
For species-rank comparison, remove one parenthesized subgenus token in the exact Genus (Subgenus) species representation; genus and specific epithet must remain unchanged.
Preserve case, diacritics, punctuation and all remaining name tokens.

statuses.accepted: The normalized COL name resolves to exactly one accepted ITIS Cercozoa species and directly equals that current ITIS name.
statuses.synonym-current-name-redirect: The normalized COL name equals official ITIS invalid species-name evidence that resolves to exactly one accepted ITIS Cercozoa species.
statuses.ambiguous: The normalized exact evidence resolves to more than one accepted ITIS Cercozoa species TSN.
statuses.unmatched: No normalized exact accepted-name or official ITIS species-synonym evidence resolves to an accepted ITIS Cercozoa species.

exactMatching.prohibited: No fuzzy, edit-distance, phonetic, case-folded, diacritic-stripped, token-reordered or taxon-substituted matching is used.

evidenceBoundary.en: This CC0 ITIS sidecar is a frozen exact nomenclatural crosswalk for the declared COL26.8 Cercozoa partition. It is not a global cercozoan checklist, a classification authority, a species-concept equivalence assertion, a biological dossier or a scientific-review record.
evidenceBoundary.zh: 此 CC0 ITIS 侧车是已声明 COL26.8 Cercozoa 分区的冻结严格命名交叉映射；它不是全球 Cercozoa 名录、分类权威、物种概念等同性声明、生物档案或科学审查记录。

colUsageIdLocator.stableAddressing: Binary-search non-overlapping inclusive colUsageId ranges; one detail query loads exactly one immutable JSONL gzip shard.

upstreamOnly.stableAddressing: No COL usage ID is assigned. The complete ITIS-only current-species partition is in its own immutable JSONL gzip shard.
